fase.TOP.temprana: Early game: manage the wave and don't lose HP for nothing
fase.TOP.media: Mid game: push your lane and use Teleport for objective fights
fase.TOP.tardia: Late game: watch your lane and don't get caught alone
fase.JUNGLE.temprana: Early game: clear your jungle efficiently and help the lanes that can win
fase.JUNGLE.media: Mid game: set up neutral objectives with vision and map presence
fase.JUNGLE.tardia: Late game: secure vision around Baron and stay with your team
fase.MIDDLE.temprana: Early game: control the wave and look for chances to roam
fase.MIDDLE.media: Mid game: group with your team for objectives
fase.MIDDLE.tardia: Late game: hold your position and don't step up without vision
fase.BOTTOM.temprana: Early game: farm calmly and play close to your support
fase.BOTTOM.media: Mid game: take towers and stay behind your frontline
fase.BOTTOM.tardia: Late game: position safely and deal steady damage in fights
fase.UTILITY.temprana: Early game: protect your ADC and buy Control Wards
fase.UTILITY.media: Mid game: ward the entrances to objectives
fase.UTILITY.tardia: Late game: always carry a Control Ward and protect your key allies

bienvenida.p1.texto: Your League of Legends coach, free and in your language: the best build for your champion before the game and in-game tips, with voice if you want. You'll be set up in a minute.
bienvenida.p1.punto1: Runes, spells, skill order and items from Emerald+ players
bienvenida.p1.punto2: In-game overlay with objectives, next skill and CS
bienvenida.p1.punto3: Only uses Riot's official APIs: it never touches the game's memory
bienvenida.p2.texto: The overlay is drawn on top of the game, so LoL has to be in Borderless mode. In Fullscreen, you won't see the overlay.
bienvenida.p3.texto: Open Coach LoL IA first, then the LoL client. When you pick a champion, the app shows their build and you decide when to send it to the game.
bienvenida.p3.paso1: Pick your champion in champ select
bienvenida.p3.paso3: It shows up in your runes and in the shop as «Coach: Champion Role»
bienvenida.p3.nota: It only touches pages that start with «Coach:». You can also turn on automatic import in Settings.
bienvenida.p4.texto: In game you'll see alerts and info about the match. One key hides or shows them, without letting go of your mouse.
bienvenida.p4.mover: To place the widgets, go to the Overlay view and press «Move & calibrate».
bienvenida.p4.listo: All set. Good luck on the Rift!

overlay.moverAyuda: Drag each widget into place and put the arrow right above your abilities. Press «Lock here», Esc or the hotkey to finish.
overlay.cs.resumen: CS {cs}, {ritmo} per minute; target {objetivo} per minute
overlay.rendimiento.mediaTitulo: Champion's average KDA in their role, from Coach LoL IA data
overlay.config.desc: Choose which widgets you see in game, their size, where they go and what the voice tells you.
overlay.config.previaDesc: This is how the widgets will look in game.
overlay.config.widgetsDesc: Turn on the ones you want and adjust their size. In game, clicks go through to LoL; only the jungle buttons, if enabled, respond when you hover over them.
overlay.config.widget.objetivosDesc: Top bar with the countdown for Voidgrubs, dragon, Herald and Baron.
overlay.config.widget.habilidadDesc: Small arrow above the skill to level up, only while you have a point to spend.
overlay.config.widget.csDesc: Your CS and CS per minute against your role's benchmark, and your KDA next to the champion's average in their role.
overlay.config.widget.compraDesc: Alert with the item icon when you can buy the next item.
overlay.config.widget.avisosDesc: Objective, vision and game phase tips, plus the enemy jungler alert.
overlay.config.moverDesc: Drag each widget into place and put the arrow right above your abilities (especially if you changed the in-game HUD scale). Esc or the {tecla} hotkey finishes.
overlay.config.moviendo: Move mode on: drag the widgets on screen and press «Lock here».
overlay.config.vozActivaDesc: One line at a time, never overlapping, with the system voice.
overlay.config.sinVoces: There are no English voices installed in Windows. Add one in Settings → Time & language → Speech.
overlay.config.vozPrueba: The Infernal Drake spawns in one minute
overlay.config.tipo.objetivo: Objectives: 1 minute before, 30 seconds before and on spawn
overlay.config.tipo.compra: When you can buy the next item
overlay.config.junglaNota: Off by default; you mark when each camp is cleared. Only your camps and the two Scuttle Crabs, never the enemy's.
overlay.config.teclasDesc: Press «Assign» and then the key: F1–F12, the numpad or a combo with Ctrl, Alt or Shift. They only work in game.
overlay.config.teclaChocaLol: {tecla} is already used by LoL (abilities, items or emotes). Choose another one, like F5 or a numpad key.
overlay.config.teclaEsOverlay: {tecla} is the overlay hotkey. Choose another one.
campeones.leyendaSinRol: The tier compares each champion's win rate (70%) and pick rate (30%) with the rest of the mode.
campeones.leyendaArena: The tier compares each champion's average placement (70%) and pick rate (30%) with the rest of Arena.
junglaEnemiga.aviso: The enemy jungler just showed up {zona} (kill)
junglaEnemiga.avisos: Enemy jungler alerts from the game events
junglaEnemiga.avisosDesc: When the enemy jungler gets a kill, an assist or dies, it tells you which area they just showed up in (at most one alert every 20 seconds, only until minute 14); when they take dragon, voidgrubs, Herald, Baron or a turret, it tells you all game. It only uses the official events the game already shows.
junglaEnemiga.rutaDesc: Based on many games on our server: which side their champion usually starts on and which lane they usually go to first. Shown on the loading screen and said once at 0:30. It's an estimate, not what they're doing in your game.
junglaEnemiga.ruta.completa: Estimate: {campeon} usually starts {inicio} and ganks {calle} around minute {minuto}
junglaEnemiga.objetivo.dragon: The enemy jungler just took the dragon
junglaEnemiga.objetivo.dragonAncestral: The enemy jungler just took the Elder Dragon
junglaEnemiga.objetivo.larvas: The enemy jungler just took the voidgrubs
junglaEnemiga.objetivo.heraldo: The enemy jungler just took the Rift Herald
junglaEnemiga.objetivo.baron: The enemy jungler just took Baron
junglaEnemiga.objetivo.atakhan: The enemy jungler just took Atakhan
junglaEnemiga.estructura.torre: The enemy jungler just took down the {calle} turret
junglaEnemiga.estructura.inhibidor: The enemy jungler just took down the {calle} inhibitor
junglaEnemiga.estructura.torreNexo: The enemy jungler just took down a nexus turret
overlay.config.tipo.junglaEnemiga: Enemy jungler: kills, objectives and usual path
jungla.minimapa.calibrar: Minimap: drag and adjust the corners
overlay.config.junglaMinimapaDesc: A small timer over each camp on the minimap, like the game's own. To line it up, use «Move & calibrate».
overlay.config.junglaPanelDesc: The list of camps in a panel, as before.
overlay.config.junglaTeclaAlternarDesc: In game, this key turns the jungle timers on or off.
overlay.config.teclaUsada: {tecla} is already used by another jungle action. Choose another one.
ajustes.idiomaDesc: Language of the app, the overlay, the voice and champion and item names.
ajustes.idiomaSinVoz: Windows has no {idioma} voice: alerts will show on screen but won't be read aloud. You can add one in Settings → Time & language → Speech.
ajustes.temaDesc: Look of the main window. “Shadow” uses a crimson accent and darker backgrounds.
overlay.config.emergentesDesc: Off by default: the voice still tells you the same things. Turn them on if you also want to see them on screen.
